# Monad

Monad is an **Engineering Knowledge Compilation Platform**: a local-first, AI-native software-engineering knowledge compiler and orchestration runtime.

This Wiki is an informational navigation surface. Canonical engineering authority lives in the repository.

## Start here

- Product goal: `product/MVP-RELEASE-1.md`
- Product backlog: `product/backlog/MVP-BACKLOG.md`
- Architecture: `architecture/overview.md`
- Architecture decisions: `architecture/decisions/`
- Engineering status: `engineering/project-status.md`
- Work Packets: `engineering/work-packets/`
- Stabilization charter: `engineering/stabilization/STABILIZATION-CHARTER.md`

## Wiki pages

- [[Engineering Operating System]]
- [[MVP Roadmap]]
- [[Artifact Authority]]
